general.summary: Overview While performing continuous red teaming exercises through Rapid7’s Vector Command service, Rapid7 discovered three new vulnerabilities in Eptura Archibus . A legacy API endpoint could be exploited to bypass authentication and run various functions without authentication ( CVSS: 8.6 High ). The most serious functions allow for full database read ( CVSS: 8.5 High ) and an insecure file upload ( CVSS: 9.6 Critical ). The insecure file upload leads to remote code execution. general.summary: Overview On October 15, 2026, BeyondTrust disclosed a critical authentication bypass in Remote Support (RS) , its platform for remotely troubleshooting and administering endpoints. Tracked as CVE-2026-102764 and assigned a CVSSv4 score of 9.3 , the vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to perform file operations on an affected appliance without user interaction. Versions 26.2.3 and earlier are affected unless the BT26-05-RS patch has been applied. BeyondTrust has confirmed that exploitation in the wild has already occurred prior to disclosure.
